[[File:Cult of the Fallen Star Screenshot.png|thumb|290x290px|The cult in the game]]
The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is a secret cult found in the {{zone|Cliffside Veins}} in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} at {{Coordinates|-45|193|45}}. To find the cult, players need to arrive between 0 AM and 6 AM in-game time on either the 7th, 14th, 21st or 28th day of each SkyBlock month. The entrance to the cult's cave is at {{Coordinates|-26|198|40}}. After going to a meeting, the player will obtain the {{ach|The Cult of the Fallen Star|ach=true}}.

After speaking to {{NPCSprite|Brarnas}} for the first time, players will be given the [[Fallen Star Helmet]]. In subsequent meetings with the cult, when the player wears the [[Fallen Star Helmet]], they will receive {{Item|Starfall|amount=200}}.

[[Silnar]] is also a member of the '''Cult''', who gives the player a [[Fallen Star Lozenge]].

== Location ==
The cult's cave is located in a hidden area of {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}; specifically, it is west of the purple crystal and up the cliff. Players can use the lava channel in the {{Zone|Lava Springs}} to access the location without having to use ender pearls.

== Trivia ==
*Meetings, except for the gap between the meetings on the 28th and the 7th, are 7 in-game days apart (2 hours and 20 minutes in real life time).
*'''Dalir''' is the only cult member players can interact with.
*Despite the message saying "come back next time" if you forget to wear the helmet, you can simply put on the helmet and then talk to Brarnas again to receive the {{Item|Starfall}}.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is likely the antithesis to the [[Armor of the Rising Sun|Rising Sun]] as they share the same naming scheme.
*There is a [[Fairy Soul]] at {{Coords|-52|205|48}}, which is accessed from their room.
*'''Thondin''' states that his favourite food is blue pizza during cult meeting #6.
**The red and blue pizzas are a reference to [[w:The Matrix|The Matrix]]'s red pill and blue pill, where the red pill represents learning an unsettling truth, and the blue pill represents remaining in comfortable ignorance.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' members are one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], [[Oen]], [[Yoshua]], and [[Skylark]].

I'll add you now. &e[NPC] &eJake&f: &b✆ &fBut don't call me after 8pm, please. }} |} == Tips == * Players can use [[Lead]]s, {{potN|Jump Boost Potion}}s, or [[Grappling Hook]]s to quickly climb up the mountain with an animal. ** The most consistent method is to use a [[Huntaxes|Huntaxe]] and [[Black Holes|Black Hole]]. Due to animals not having shards, they will float permanently into the black hole. You can move the black hole towards the mountain, taking as many animals as you wish at once. Move the black hole repeatedly until the animals levitate on top of the hut's roof. ** The classic method is to combine a lead with [[Spider's Boots]] or [[Tarantula Boots]] and double-jump to the very top. The animal will only take damage based on the distance from its highest point to the elevation of the spot it lands on, so it will take minimal damage only once when it lands on top of the mountain. The mana cost of these abilities can be reduced with a {{Item|Sheep Pet}} or {{Item|Tarantula Pet}}. ** Another method, although more difficult and expensive, is to use Spirit Boots to fly up the mountain. The boots will get you up the mountain in 2 flights because flights are very short. ** In order to get a Cow or Pig, it's recommended to land in the oasis to reset the potential fall damage before going up the mountain. *The Loch Emperor is not consumed from the summoning item after talking to Jake, meaning the player can unlock the Golden Ball item an infinite amount of times as long as they have the summon. == Gallery == File:Jake (Underground Lab).png|'''Jake''' while in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Crop Analyzer (Area).png|Crop Analyzer and '''Jake''' in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Jake's House (Render).png|[[Jake's House]] on top of the mountain == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 10|link=none|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|2026/July 15|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} {{History|2026/Oct 15|Moved '''Jake''' and his house from {{Coords|261.5|184|-565.5}} to {{Coords|245.5|95|-344.5}}.}} |beta= {{History|2021/April 21|[[File:Jake.png|26px]] Added '''Jake'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|0.26.1|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Beth&f: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &61&f meeting of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Attend two more and I'll give you my &3Abiphone Contact&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The master plan.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Right, the master plan. &5Thondin&f, care to update us?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was &5Brarnas&f! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You said you never even saw the plates.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And I didn't! But &5Brarnas&f told me about it.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: No I didn't.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Anyways!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Try not to break those too.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cool.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I don't think that would work.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Sure.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Jobs may come and go, but the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f is eternal.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: You are right. I shall be there.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Awesome.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, next point of interest...
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Cat again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cat again. I've got to go.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &62&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Attend one more and I'll give you my &3Abiphone Contact&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Today I have something I'd like to talk about.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: What is it?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: The sleepover.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Uh-oh.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: We're never having another one again.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Why?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I wonder why. Where do I start?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: We were hungry.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You're not helping.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You don't even know which two people died!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: TWO?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Might be three in a minute.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You deserved that spoiler. And-
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: You can pay for the pizza.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Yes.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Again, &5Thondin&f?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Apologies.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Cat again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Nope, wife.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Oh. That's not good.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in &5Scarleton&f. Thought it was her day off.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Yep.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!}}

§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: I wonder why. Where do I start?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You didn't take your shows off when you came in.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You also left the door open, so the cat ran out and I had to spend an hour looking for him.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: And, while I was doing that, you ate all of the pizza I ordered for us.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: We were hungry.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: We? I didn't get a single bite either.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: You're not helping.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You then fell asleep in my bed before the show we were meant to watch even began.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You don't even know which two people died!
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: TWO?
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Might be three in a minute.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: You deserved that spoiler. And-
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Okay, okay, I get it. The next sleepover can be at my house. I'll make it up to you guys.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: You can pay for the pizza.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Yes, of course! Now, can we move on with the meeting?
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Yes.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Again, §5Thondin§f?
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Apologies.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Hello? Missing? Again? Okay. Yep, I can hear you. I'll be right there.

§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Nope, wife.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Oh. That's not good.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: Nah, it's fine. She'll be getting a cuppa down in §5Scarleton§f. Thought it was her day off.
§e[NPC] §5Thondin§f: I should probably go and tell her that she's supposed to be at work.
§e[NPC] §5Brarnas§f: Yep.
§e[NPC] §5Dalir§f: Well, I guess we will have to suspend today's meeting... Until next week, everyone!

&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: And how did you reach that conclusion?

&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Like, you could just walk right on in to the dwarven palace, if it wasn't for the guards.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And guards, thoughthey serve a similar purpose, are not doors, I suppose.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Yeah. Unless you're like, a philosopher, or something.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And then, when you think about it, every minecart has four wheels, but no door on it.

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Me neither!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The same is true for me.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys... are we living in a simulation?

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Beth&f: I... I had no idea this was here. What could Jake be hiding in this secret part of the lab?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: It's very dark in here, where's the light-switch in this place?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh... my... what is all of this?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThis is... this isn't just about plushies anymore. Jake's been working on something much bigger.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Hybridization? &cMutation&f? What is this madness? He's experimenting on something...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Resilient livestock... enhanced growth rates... Jake, what have you done?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThese aren't normal &acrops&f. These are &cmutated&f... just like the ones we've been finding in the Garden. But why hide all of this down here?
&8&oA door opens from within the lab, and Jake shows up
&e[NPC] Jake&f: Beth... I told you to stay out of this.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Jake! You have a lot of explaining to do, once again... What is all of this? What are you doing down here?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: Please tell me the truth this time Jake, I can't take all these lies anymore!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's... it's not what it looks like. This lab... it's for research. To improve farming techniques, to help both &acrops &fand &eanimals &fadapt to new environments.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &bResearch&f? This doesn't look like research, Jake! This looks like you are playing with life itself. Those tanks, those animals, what are you actually doing to them?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fYou don't understand, Beth! Farming as we know is evolving. If we don't adapt, we'll be left behind. The world's demands are growing, and so are the challenges.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThat doesn't give you the right to hide this from everyone. What about the risks? The ethics?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fYou're creating something entirely unnatural.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &f&osigh &fI know it seems... wrong. But these experiments could change everything.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fImagine crops that can survive the harshest conditions, or animals that never get sick.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's not just about survival, it's about thriving.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fAnd what about the things you are not telling me? What else are you hiding down here, Jake?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThere are some things you're better off not knowing. Not yet at least.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fNo, Jake. I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. It's not about keeping secrets, it's about protecting what I've been working towards.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fProtecting what? Your pride? Your experiments? This isn't just about you, Jake. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7<player> &fhelp you.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together.
&e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7<player>&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust.
}}

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: I've seen it in my flames, you are destined for great things.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: I've seen it in my flames, you are destined for great things.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: Я видел в пламени: тебе суждены великие дела.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: For now, you shouldn't let it get to your head.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: For now, you shouldn't let it get to your head.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: Но пока не стоит зазнаваться.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Абифон? Что это за колдовство?

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ An Abiphone? What kind of witchcraft is that?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Абифон? Что это за колдовство?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ I see.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ I see.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Понятно.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Turns out I own one too. I never knew what it was called.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Turns out I own one too. I never knew what it was called.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Оказывается, у меня тоже такой есть. Я и не знал, как он называется.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ So, you want me to add you?

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ So, you want me to add you?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Значит, хочешь попасть в мои контакты?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Get me a stack of Mutant Nether Wart.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Get me a stack of Mutant Nether Wart.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Принеси мне стак мутировавшего адского нароста.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ You have less warts than I have on my face!

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ You have less warts than I have on my face!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ У тебя наростов меньше, чем у меня бородавок на лице!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ I was right, you are indeed destined for great things.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ I was right, you are indeed destined for great things.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: ✆ Я был прав: тебе и впрямь суждены великие дела.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Been running low on my brewing supplies, Nether Warts are quite hard to come by these days.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Been running low on my brewing supplies, Nether Warts are quite hard to come by these days.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: Ингредиенты для зелий заканчиваются. В наши дни адский нарост непросто раздобыть.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Project Centurion can finally begin. You've been quite the help.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Project Centurion can finally begin. You've been quite the help.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: Наконец-то можно начинать проект «Центурион». Ты очень помог.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Unfortunate, I'll see if I can find some Nether Warts from someone else.

original_resources.speaker: Alchemist
original_resources.source: [NPC] Alchemist: Unfortunate, I'll see if I can find some Nether Warts from someone else.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Alchemist: Жаль. Попробую раздобыть адский нарост у кого-нибудь другого.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: That Jake fellow is a bit suspicious.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Этот Jake какой-то подозрительный.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: He says he can't leave his house but I've seen him walking around all the time...
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Он говорит, что не может выйти из дома, но я постоянно вижу, как он гуляет...

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: I think I am really onto something here.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: I think I am really onto something here.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Кажется, я действительно напала на след.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: Jake says he can't walk, but I've seen him walk yesterday.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Jake говорит, что не может ходить, но вчера я сама видела, как он ходит.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: He also asks strangers to get him some animals, but these animals are nowhere to be found!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: А ещё он просит незнакомцев принести ему животных, которых нигде не найти!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: I'm getting really close to solving this mystery.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Я уже совсем близка к разгадке этой тайны.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: I followed him today to where he brings all the animals he catches. He goes down some weird cave...
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Сегодня я проследила, куда он относит пойманных животных. Он спускается в какую-то странную пещеру...

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Не могу поверить, что всё это было здесь столько времени... У меня нет слов.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! Jake is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: WHAT? There are animals inside of here?!?! Jake is doing horrible experiments with these animals that he catches...
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: ЧТО? Здесь внутри животные?!?! Jake проводит ужасные эксперименты над этими животными, которых он ловит...

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Он совсем обезумел! Он психопат!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: What is this psycho doing with these animals???

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: What is this psycho doing with these animals???
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Что этот псих делает с этими животными???

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: Jake has a lot of explaining to do!

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: Jake has a lot of explaining to do!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Jake придётся многое объяснить!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: ЭТО НЕ ТО, ЧТО ВЫ ДУМАЕТЕ!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE ANIMALS!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: МЫ ЗНАЕМ, ЧТО ТЫ ЗДЕСЬ ДЕЛАЕШЬ, ПСИХ! ТЫ ОТВЕТИШЬ ЗА ТО, ЧТО ДЕЛАЕШЬ С ЭТИМИ ЖИВОТНЫМИ!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: ANIMALS? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: ANIMALS? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: ЖИВОТНЫЕ? КЛЯНУСЬ, Я МОГУ ОБЪЯСНИТЬ!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: НУ ТАК ДАВАЙ, ОБЪЯСНЯЙ!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my workshop!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my workshop!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Не знаю, что вы себе представили, но это всего лишь моя мастерская!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: I am just making toys for animals...

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: I am just making toys for animals...
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Я просто делаю игрушки для животных...

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Правда? Ты действительно считаешь нас такими наивными?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: We know that you are experimenting with animals down here, how do you explain this tank?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Мы знаем, что ты ставишь здесь опыты над животными. Как ты объяснишь этот резервуар?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: Those are my plushies! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: Those are my plushies! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Это мои мягкие игрушки! Я храню их в желе, чтобы они оставались как новые!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: They look super realistic, but no animal was harmed when making them!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Они выглядят как настоящие, но при их изготовлении ни одно животное не пострадало!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the plushies I made, you can have it!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the plushies I made, you can have it!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Я могу это доказать! Вот, возьми. Это одна из моих мягких игрушек — дарю её тебе!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: So really, I am not harming them at all!

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: So really, I am not harming them at all!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Так что на самом деле я совсем им не врежу!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Теперь всё понятно... Прости, что накричала на тебя, Jake. Мне очень жаль.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Jake: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.

original_resources.speaker: Jake
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jake: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jake: Теперь всё хорошо. Не стоило врать — надо было рассказать вам раньше.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Beth: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.

original_resources.speaker: Beth
original_resources.source: [NPC] Beth: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Beth: Мне пора. Надеюсь, скоро снова вас увижу.

original_resources.speaker: Jerry
original_resources.source: [NPC] Jerry: Jerry.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jerry: Джерри.

original_resources.source: [NPC] Jerry: Jerry?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jerry: Джерри?

original_resources.source: [NPC] Jerry: Jerry!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Jerry: Джерри!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: Hey there, I'm George the Pet Collector!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: Привет! Я Джордж, коллекционер питомцев!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: I travel the world searching far and wide for the rarest pets I can find!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: Я путешествую по всему миру в поисках самых редких питомцев!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: If you have any pets which need a new home I'd be happy to buy them off you!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: Если твоим питомцам нужен новый дом, я с радостью их куплю!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: Your Taming level cap has been increased!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: Your Taming level cap has been increased!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: Максимальный уровень приручения повышен!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: Thank you for bringing me this pet!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: Thank you for bringing me this pet!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: Спасибо, что принёс мне этого питомца!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Oh absolutely you can have my contact info.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Конечно, я дам тебе свой номер.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ It may look like I'm always here at my desk, but really I'm always traveling.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ It may look like I'm always here at my desk, but really I'm always traveling.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Кажется, будто я всегда сижу за столом, но на самом деле я постоянно путешествую.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Lately I've been looking across the universe for 3 specific pets.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Lately I've been looking across the universe for 3 specific pets.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ В последнее время я ищу по всей вселенной 3 определённых питомцев.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ If you can bring me ALL of those, you can have my contact!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Принесёшь их ВСЕХ — получишь мой номер!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl 1.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Oh, by the way, they should all be Lvl 1.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Кстати, у всех должен быть 1-й уровень.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ That's fantastic!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ That's fantastic!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Замечательно!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ I love pets!

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ I love pets!
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Обожаю питомцев!

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Here take my contact.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ Here take my contact.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Вот мой номер.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] George: ✆ You'll be able to reach me while I am or you are in the wilderness.

original_resources.speaker: George
original_resources.source: [NPC] George: ✆ You'll be able to reach me while I am or you are in the wilderness.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] George: ✆ Теперь мы сможем связаться, даже если кто-то из нас в глуши.

original_resources.speaker: Jerry

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: So listen.

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: So listen.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Так вот, слушайте.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: The other day I was chumming with my chums.

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: The other day I was chumming with my chums.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Недавно мы с приятелями рыбачили с прикормкой.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Один из них болтает без умолку, а я спрашиваю: «Мой тоник пробовал?»

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: И вот, возвращаюсь я к себе домой, понимаете?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Никого раньше тут внизу не встречал, но вы вроде славный человек.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Слушай, светящиеся грибы, кажется, не очень полезны для моего здоровья. Пора попробовать что-нибудь другое. Что-нибудь найдётся, приятель?

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Moby: That's good.

original_resources.speaker: Moby
original_resources.source: [NPC] Moby: That's good.
original_resources.translation: [NPC] Moby: Вот и хорошо.

retained_originals.source: [NPC] Shaggy: I wish peace upon you.

original_resources.speaker: Shaggy

original_resources.translation: [NPC] Shaggy: Мира тебе.
